name: title
text: How we train and check the model
textPreview: How we train and check the model

name: train-body
text:
Use approved speech pairs.
Add small speed/noise changes only to source training audio.
Fine-tune with LoRA.
textPreview: Use approved speech pairs. | Add small speed/noise changes only to source training audio. | Fine-tune with LoRA.

name: validate-body
text:
Do not change validation audio.
Check loss after each training stage.
Keep the best checkpoint.
textPreview: Do not change validation audio. | Check loss after each training stage. | Keep the best checkpoint.

name: test-body
text:
Generate Spanish speech.
Use frozen Spanish ASR for ASR-BLEU.
Ask people to rate quality and measure latency.
textPreview: Generate Spanish speech. | Use frozen Spanish ASR for ASR-BLEU. | Ask people to rate quality and measure latency.
